body:
**Type:** Feature · **Priority:** P1

## Existing capability and narrow gap

Hive Mind already implemented native parent/sub-issue and blocker-aware scheduling in **#2615 (closed)**. Reuse:

- [hive.issue-relations.lib.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/src/hive.issue-relations.lib.mjs)
- [hive.issue-queue.lib.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/src/hive.issue-queue.lib.mjs)
- [hive.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/src/hive.mjs)
- [hive-issue-relations-2615.test.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/tests/hive-issue-relations-2615.test.mjs)

The gap is the **separate issue-created Formal AI draft path**. [decideDraft](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/scripts/formal-ai-draft.lib.mjs) checks event/author and opt-out/drafted labels but not native dependencies. Its decision is consumed by both repositories. As a result, opening a dependency-ordered backlog can start expensive attempts for blocked issues.

This issue owns Hive's integration into that path. [Formal AI #1490](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/1490) owns its caller/workflow integration and cross-repository acceptance. Do not build a second general dependency graph or queue engine.

## Required change

1. Wire the existing relations gate and ready-frontier logic into cheap issue-open preflight before image preparation or source compilation.
2. Cover the race where blockers are attached immediately after creation: bounded settling plus a fresh dependency check immediately before expensive work/effect claims.
3. Emit structured deferred outcomes with blocker identities and zero execution credit, using the shared outcome work linked below.
4. Wake affected work when prerequisites become ready. Reuse queue deduplication, waiting-state handling, concurrency and dispatch recheck. A dependency closure is a scheduling signal; any required implementation qualification remains a separate checked condition.
5. Preserve the existing parent/inherited blocker and cycle handling, plus opt-out labels and bot-loop protection. Make incomplete/failing relationship reads an explicit caller policy: the current /hive gate fails open on fetch failure, but authoritative draft preflight must defer/report unknown rather than assuming an issue is ready. Reuse the shared implementation with a tested policy boundary; do not silently change the regular /hive default.
6. Allow a recorded maintainer override without relabeling unresolved prerequisites as successful.
7. Coordinate source-keyed artifact reuse with Formal AI #1486. Keep blocked intake cheap and per-attempt evidence distinct.

## Acceptance

- [ ] For A → B → C, only A enters expensive execution initially; independent D can proceed concurrently.
- [ ] A blocker attached just after opening B is observed before expensive work.
- [ ] Resolving prerequisites resumes a dependent once; duplicate webhook events do not duplicate drafts.
- [ ] Reopening a prerequisite before an effect claim defers the dependent; claimed effects follow existing ownership rules.
- [ ] Reuse the #2615 graph fixtures and add only the issue-open integration/race/continuation cases.
- [ ] Cycles, missing access and incomplete relation data yield truthful blocked/error outcomes. A failed relation fetch never admits an issue-open draft as ready; regression tests preserve the explicitly selected policy for other callers.
- [ ] Both Hive's and Formal AI's issue-created workflows honor the same decision.
- [ ] No Rust/Docker execution is needed for the fast decision/queue regression tests.

## Dependencies

**Blocked by:** #3910 (structured draft outcomes). **Blocks:** link-assistant/formal-ai#1490's cross-repository completion.

The temporary `no-formal-ai-draft` label defers this issue's expensive initial attempt. Remove it and dispatch when the prerequisite is accepted; the completed integration will automate readiness handling.
title: [Feature][P1] Reuse /hive's dependency gate for issue-created Formal AI drafts and resume ready work
